Deep Testing Report · 1.6.0 release candidate

Stack'd Minimalist 1.6.0

A hands-on review of every major flow in the app: boards, tasks and repeating tasks, the Kanban and its lanes, notes, search, the archive and the bin, meetings and their action cards, settings, import and export, the sign-in sheet, offline use and accessibility. Each criterion is listed with its outcome, and every bug comes with reproduction steps and annotated evidence.

Reviewed Fri 20 – Sat 21 Nov 2026 · Build 1.6.0 on release/1.6.0 · commit 2edef72 · TestFlight build 15 · Scope 52 criteria · 19 bugs · 22 figures

Update, 21 November 2026: where it stands after the fixes and build 18

The report below is the review as it was carried out on commit 2edef72. Since then 18 of the 19 bugs have been fixed, in three batches, and each fix was checked by running the failing steps again in the same test set-up. Every bug page now starts with its status.

18bugs fixed and re-checked
1bug still open (BUG-02)
11 of 12failed criteria fixed since
3criteria still need a device or a server

What is left before a store release: BUG-02 (the Privacy Policy and Terms: the owner's details, the lawyer's read, the site going live), and the blocked criteria on real devices. On an iPhone, the owner has confirmed BUG-01 and the keyboard fix in build 17; the other fixes have not been tried on a phone or with a screen reader yet.

Also changed, from notes in the report

  • Deleting a subtask had no Undo. It now shows "Subtask deleted · Undo", and Undo puts the subtask back in its place.
  • Removing a lane had no Undo. The "Lane removed" message has Undo. It puts the lane back where it was with its cards, including cards that had gone to Deleted.
  • The Developer field accepted any https address. An address that is neither the Stack'd service nor this computer is asked about first: "Send your meetings to {host}?". Cancel keeps the old address.

Found on the iPhone in build 17

Stack'd Minimalist is a to-do app built around boards. Each board is a list and a Kanban of the same tasks, with lanes the user names. Tasks carry a due date, a repeat rule, a priority, tags, subtasks and a reminder. Next to the boards sit Notes (formatted text with checklists) and Meetings, where a meeting is recorded or pasted in, turned into a transcript and AI minutes, and its action points become tasks. Archived and Deleted keep what is put away, the latter for 30 days.

Everything is stored on the device and works offline. An optional account (new in 1.6.0, not live yet) syncs boards, notes and meetings across devices and allows shared boards. The app is for adults who want a calm, quick task list on phone and computer; the paid plans serve people who sit in many meetings.

Build under test

  • Source at commit 2edef72 on release/1.6.0, the same code as TestFlight build 15. No uncommitted changes.
  • The web build served from the project folder and driven with Playwright Chromium in a Pixel 7 profile: 412 × 839 CSS px, touch, en-US, Europe/Rome. Touch gestures (taps, holds, drags, swipes) were sent as real touch events.
  • Test data entered through the UI on top of the sample boards: 6 boards, about 20 tasks with 4 repeating ones, 5 lanes added or renamed, 4 notes, 2 meetings (one recorded with a test microphone, one pasted). Plus stress profiles of 1,000 and 5,000 tasks.
  • Passes in light and dark themes, at phone size and at 1280 px desktop size, online and offline. Suspected defects were confirmed in the source before being reported.
  • Outside requests were blocked and logged, so the AI service, sign-in and purchases could not complete; see the blocked and skipped criteria.

2 Executive summary

52criteria reviewed
37passed
12failed
2 + 1blocked + skipped
19bugs · 2 high · 6 medium · 11 low

Overall result

  • ✓ Pass 37 · 71%
  • ✕ Fail 12 · 23%
  • ‖ Blocked 2 · 4%
  • ↷ Skipped 1 · 2%

The pass rate counts only the 49 criteria that were executed. Blocked items need a phone, a store purchase or the live AI service; the skipped one is covered by the project's own test suites.

Headline findings

  1. The core is sound. Tasks, repeating dates, sorting, the Kanban gestures, lanes, notes, the archive and the 30-day bin all behaved as specified, and every delete that should be undoable was.
  2. Hostile content is contained. Scripts and handlers pasted into a note, typed into a tag, pasted as a transcript or hidden in an import file were shown as text or stripped. Nothing ran.
  3. Two high-severity defects. Picking a board in the menu also opens a task (BUG-01), and the Privacy Policy and Terms are unfinished and unreachable (BUG-02).
  4. One control is dead and one is a placeholder. Deleting a label does nothing (BUG-03), and "Add automation" leads to "coming soon" (BUG-07).
  5. Two quiet errors. A card can drop into the wrong lane after the board scrolls (BUG-04), and month-end repeating tasks drift to the 28th (BUG-06).
  6. The privacy and offline claims hold, with one gap. No request leaves the device on its own and the app works without a connection. But a Free user's first Transcribe uploads the recording before the plan is checked (BUG-05).
Recommendation: fine to keep testing in TestFlight. Not ready for a store release until six fixes land. The foundations are strong and nothing found loses data. The blocking items are few and local: a navigation tap that opens the wrong screen, a dead button, a misfiled card, an early upload, a placeholder on the main action, and the legal pages. Fix those six, re-test, and the app is ready to go to the stores. Details in section 6.

BUG-01 ▲ High Navigation › Main menu C-03

Picking a board in the main menu also opens a task

✓ Fixed · commit 853216d All four boards open from the menu with no task opening; a row tap still opens its task. Confirmed by the owner on an iPhone in build 17.

Observation

In the main menu, a tap on Personal, Shopping or Family opens the board and, with the same tap, the task whose row sits under the finger on the new screen. Work is spared only because its row lines up with the List / Kanban switch. The menu changes the screen when the finger lifts; the browser then delivers the click to whatever is now at that point, and task rows open on a click.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open the app on a phone-sized screen with the sample boards.
  2. Tap the Boards icon in the bottom bar to open the main menu.
  3. Tap Personal.

Expected

The Personal board, in list view.

Actual

The detail of "Call the dentist" on the Personal board. Shopping opens "Birthday card for Sam", Family opens "Call grandma". 4 out of 4 attempts.

Impact on users and the business

Changing board is the most frequent move in the app, and three times out of four it ends on the wrong screen. People must press Back every time, and may edit a task they never meant to open. Reproduced in Chromium, the engine of the Android app; it was not reported from the iPhone builds, so confirm it there.

Direction for the fix

After the menu handles a tap, swallow the click that follows (the gesture code already does this after a drag or a hold), or change the screen on the click event instead of on pointer-up.

Where src/ui/shell.js:132 (board rows use bindHold → onTap on pointer-up); src/ui/board.js:410 (task rows open on click)

BUG-02 ▲ High Legal › Privacy Policy and Terms C-50

Privacy Policy and Terms have unfilled placeholders, and their links do not open

● Open Open. Needs the owner's details, the lawyer's read and the site going live.

Observation

The project's own check prints "privacy.html has 5 [OWNER: …] placeholder(s) to fill before 1.6.0" and "terms.html has 3". The app links both pages at app.stackdplatform.com (sign-in sheet, Settings › Account, Settings › Plan), an address that is not live, so the links open nothing.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Run npm run check and read the check-origins lines.
  2. In the app, open Settings › Account › Sign in › Create an account, pass the age step, and tap Terms or Privacy Policy.

Expected

Complete documents that open from every link.

Actual

Eight placeholders, and links to a site that is not deployed.

Impact on users and the business

Both stores require a working privacy policy link, and accounts cannot open to the public on unfinished terms. This blocks a store release; it does not block TestFlight testing.

Direction for the fix

Fill the eight placeholders, have the lawyer read both pages, deploy the site, and make check-origins fail (not only warn) while a placeholder remains.

Where privacy.html, terms.html; src/legal.js (TERMS_URL, PRIVACY_URL); scripts/check-origins.mjs

BUG-03 ◆ Medium Settings › Labels C-43

Deleting a label does nothing

✓ Fixed · commit 853216d The bin asks "Delete #errand?" and removes the label from its task.

Observation

The bin next to a label in Settings › Labels has no effect: no question, no message, the label stays and so do its tasks. The handler calls tagUseCount, but the file imports tagUseCounts, so the press ends in "tagUseCount is not defined". Seen four times in the console.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Settings and scroll to Labels.
  2. Press the bin next to "errand" (or any label).

Expected

"Delete #errand? It is removed from 1 task", then the label goes.

Actual

Nothing happens.

Impact on users and the business

A whole control is dead, so labels can never be removed once created. Nothing is lost, but it looks broken. No check caught it, because nothing checks for names that do not exist.

Direction for the fix

Call tagUseCounts(name) and add its parts, or import tagUseCount. Add a lint rule for undefined names (no-undef) to npm run check so this class of mistake cannot ship.

Where src/ui/settings.js:325 (call) and :7 (import)

BUG-04 ◆ Medium Kanban › Drag C-22

After the board scrolls by itself, a card drops into the wrong lane

✓ Fixed · commit 853216d A card held at the edge after the board scrolled, with no lane under it, stays in its own lane.

Observation

While a card is held near the right edge, the board scrolls. The lane under the finger is only worked out when the finger moves. If the finger rests while the board scrolls, the ring stays on the lane it was over before, now far off screen, and letting go drops the card there.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open a board with four or more lanes in Kanban view.
  2. Hold a card in the first lane until it lifts.
  3. Drag it to the right edge and keep the finger still while the board scrolls to the end.
  4. Let go.

Expected

The card lands in the lane under the finger, or stays where it was if no lane is there.

Actual

The card moved to In Progress, a lane 872 px off screen, while the finger was over the empty space next to Add lane.

Impact on users and the business

A card filed in the wrong lane without any sign of it; the user finds out later, if at all. It happens exactly when a board is wide enough to need scrolling.

Direction for the fix

Work out the lane again on every auto-scroll step, from the last pointer position, and when the finger lifts.

Where src/ui/board.js:540–546 (overLane is set in onDragMove only); src/ui/gestures.js autoScroll

BUG-05 ◆ Medium Meetings › AI steps C-38

On a Free device, the first Transcribe sends the recording before the plan is checked

✓ Fixed · commit 853216d Server unreachable: one plan request, no upload, a message. Free answer: the plan sheet opens, nothing is uploaded, the button is locked afterwards.

Observation

The Transcribe and Summarise buttons are locked for Free users only after the plan has been checked once, and the plan is only checked from Settings › Plan. On a device that never opened that section, a Free user who presses Transcribe (after the notice) uploads the recording; the server then answers that a plan is needed. The same goes for Summarise and the transcript.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Install fresh, stay on the Free plan, do not open Settings › Plan.
  2. Record a short meeting.
  3. Press Transcribe, then Continue on the notice.

Expected

The plan sheet, with no upload ("Free: the paywall, no request").

Actual

A POST to /v1/transcribe with the recording. Only the answer triggers the plan sheet.

Impact on users and the business

Up to 30 minutes of audio leaves the phone, on mobile data, for a step the user cannot use. It also weakens the promise that Free users send nothing.

Direction for the fix

Before the upload, call allowance() when the plan has never been checked, and open the plan sheet if the answer is Free. Also check the plan once at start-up when online.

Where src/ui/paywall.js:34 (unlocked while never checked); src/ai.js:199–215 (no check before upload); allowance() is only called from paywall.js:111, 121, 148

BUG-06 ◆ Medium Tasks › Repeat C-14

A monthly task due on the 29th to 31st drifts to the 28th

✓ Fixed · commit a17c2bb 31 Jan → 28 Feb → 31 Mar → 30 Apr → 31 May. Eight month-end and leap-day cases added to the project's date checks. A task made before the fix keeps the old behaviour until its date or rule is saved again.

Observation

The next date is worked out from the current due date alone. 31 January correctly becomes 28 February, but from there the task repeats on the 28th: 28 March, 28 April and so on. The original day is not kept.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Create a task due 31 January with Repeat: Monthly.
  2. Complete it twice.

Expected

28 February, then 31 March.

Actual

28 February, then 28 March.

Impact on users and the business

Rent, salary and other month-end items move three days early and stay there. A reminder set on them moves too. The user is never told.

Direction for the fix

Keep the day of the month the series started on (for example recurDay) and use it when adding a month, clamped to the length of the month. Add the case to check-dates.

Where src/dates.js:24 (addMonths) and :44 (monthly rule); scripts/check-dates.mjs:81 covers only the first step

BUG-07 ◆ Medium Navigation › Add menu C-07

"Add automation" leads to a "coming soon" row

✓ Fixed · commit 853216d The fourth tile is Add board and opens New board; the "coming soon" row is gone from Settings.

Observation

The "+" grid has four tiles of equal weight. Add automation opens Settings scrolled to Automations, where the only thing to see is "New automation · Custom rules are coming soon · Soon".

Steps to reproduce

  1. Tap "+" on any page.
  2. Tap Add automation.

Expected

A way to add an automation, or no tile.

Actual

A placeholder.

Impact on users and the business

One of the four main actions is a dead end, on the most visible control in the app. App Store review rejects apps with placeholder features (guideline 2.2, beta and demo content).

Direction for the fix

Remove the tile until custom rules exist (three tiles, or bring Add board in as the fourth), and drop the "Soon" row from Settings.

Where src/ui/addmenu.js (automation tile); src/ui/settings.js (Automations section)

BUG-08 ◆ Medium Accessibility › Task list C-48

In the list, a task cannot be opened from the keyboard, and every checkbox has the same name

✓ Fixed · commit a17c2bb A list row takes focus and opens with Enter; circles read "Complete: {title}", the swipe button "Delete: {title}"; plain menu actions are menu items. Not checked with a screen reader.

Observation

In list view the Tab key reaches each task's checkbox and never the task itself, so there is no keyboard way to open a task (Kanban cards do take focus and open on Enter). All checkboxes are named "Toggle complete", and all swipe buttons "Delete", without the task's title. The action menus also mark plain actions as unchecked options.

Steps to reproduce

  1. On a desktop browser, open a board in list view.
  2. Press Tab until the focus is in the list.
  3. Listen with a screen reader, or read the accessibility names.

Expected

Each row can be focused and opened with Enter; "Complete: Call the dentist".

Actual

Five identical "Toggle complete" stops and no way into a task.

Impact on users and the business

People who use a keyboard, a switch or a screen reader cannot open or tell apart their tasks in the default view. This fails WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.6 (Headings and Labels).

Direction for the fix

Give list rows tabindex="0", role="button" and an Enter handler, as the Kanban cards have. Put the task title in the checkbox and Delete labels. Use role="menuitem" without aria-checked for actions.

Where src/ui/board.js (list row markup and bindSwipe); src/ui/primitives.js (openMenu items)

BUG-09 ● Low Feedback › Toasts C-31

The toast lies on top of the action sheet and takes its taps

✓ Fixed · commit a17c2bb Archive works on the first tap straight after Copy. A toast takes taps only on its own button.

Observation

A toast stays for about three seconds and is drawn above sheets. After Copy ("Copied") or Move, opening ⋯ again puts the toast right over the Archive row. A tap on the middle of that row hits the toast and nothing happens. Seen on tasks and on notes. On the task screen the same toast covers the Add subtask field.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open a note or a task and choose ⋯ › Copy.
  2. Open ⋯ again straight away and tap Archive.

Expected

The item is archived.

Actual

Nothing; the sheet stays open until the toast has gone and the row is tapped again.

Impact on users and the business

Looks like a button that does not work. Small, but it hits people who work fast.

Direction for the fix

Dismiss the current toast when a sheet opens, or show toasts above the sheet's top edge, or let taps pass through the toast outside its Undo button.

Where styles/components.css (toast position and z-index); src/ui/primitives.js (toast, openMenu)

BUG-10 ● Low Tasks › Tags C-18

A long tag runs off the card and cannot be removed there

✓ Fixed · commit a17c2bb The tag field stops at 30 characters; a stored 60-character tag stays inside the card with its ✕ in view.

Observation

The tag field has no length limit. A 60-character tag is drawn on one line that runs past the right edge of the card, so its ✕ is off screen. The same tag stretches the Archived row.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open a task, tap Add under Tags.
  2. Type 60 characters and press Add.

Expected

A limit on length, or a tag that wraps or is cut with its ✕ in reach.

Actual

The chip overflows the card.

Impact on users and the business

Cosmetic, but the only way to remove the tag from that task is no longer on screen (deleting labels in Settings is broken too, see BUG-03).

Direction for the fix

Limit tags to about 30 characters in the picker, and give chips max-width: 100% with an ellipsis.

Where src/ui/tagpicker.js (no maxlength); styles/components.css (.chip)

BUG-11 ● Low Boards, lanes, priorities C-02

Two boards, lanes or priorities can have the same name

✓ Fixed · commit a17c2bb A second "backlog" lane, "WORK" board and "high" priority are each refused with a message.

Observation

A second "side project" board, a "review" lane next to "Review", and an "urgent" priority next to "Urgent" were all accepted. Tags, by contrast, treat the two spellings as one.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Settings › Priorities › Add priority: type "urgent" when "Urgent" exists.
  2. Or add a lane with the name of an existing lane.

Expected

"There is already a priority called Urgent."

Actual

A second one with the same name.

Impact on users and the business

Pickers show two entries that look alike (Move to, the priority chips), and sorting by priority becomes hard to read.

Direction for the fix

Refuse a name that already exists in the same list, ignoring case, with a short message.

Where src/store.js (addList, addLane, addPriority)

BUG-12 ● Low Meetings › Recording C-36

Record does nothing, without a word, when the recording store cannot be opened

✓ Fixed · commit a17c2bb With the recording store failing, Record shows "Recordings can't be saved on this device right now." and does not start.

Observation

Recordings are kept in the browser's database. When that database cannot be opened (here after a crash of the test browser; the same happens in some private modes and when storage is damaged), pressing Record does nothing. The failure is not caught, so no message appears.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Use a browser profile whose IndexedDB cannot be opened.
  2. Open a meeting and press Record.

Expected

"Recording is not available on this device right now", as the app already says for a missing microphone.

Actual

Nothing changes on screen.

Impact on users and the business

Rare, but the user has no idea why the main button of the meeting screen is dead.

Direction for the fix

Catch storage errors in record() and startRecording() and show a toast; hide Record when the store cannot be opened at all.

Where src/ui/recorder.js:259–270 (record) and startRecording; src/media.js:18 (open rejects)

BUG-13 ● Low Forms C-11

An empty title or board name is refused without a message

✓ Fixed · commit a17c2bb Add task and the name dialogs keep their button disabled until something is typed.

Observation

Add task with no title keeps the sheet open and puts the cursor back in the field; nothing says why. New board with no name closes the dialog as if it had worked. The dates dialog shows the better pattern: a line of text and a disabled Save.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Tap "+" › Add task, then Add task with the title empty.
  2. Or: New board › Personal, then Create with the name empty.

Expected

"Give the task a title", or a disabled button.

Actual

No feedback (task); the dialog closes (board).

Impact on users and the business

Minor confusion on the first thing a new user does.

Direction for the fix

Disable the button until there is a title, as the composer and the dates dialog do.

Where src/ui/addsheet.js (submit); src/ui/sharing.js newBoardFlow

BUG-14 ● Low Tasks › Priority C-17

Priority chips run in opposite orders on two screens

✓ Fixed · commit a17c2bb The task detail lists High, Medium, Low, None, as the New task sheet does.

Observation

The New task sheet lists High, Medium, Low, None. The task detail lists None, Low, Medium, High. After the priorities are reordered in Settings, the detail shows them last to first.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open New task and look at Priority.
  2. Open any task and look at Priority.

Expected

The same order in both places, the one set in Settings.

Actual

Reversed in the detail.

Impact on users and the business

A small stumble each time; easy to pick the wrong chip by habit.

Direction for the fix

Render both from S.priorities in the same order, with None last.

Where src/ui/detail.js (priority chips); src/ui/addsheet.js

BUG-15 ● Low Accessibility › Touch C-48

Many touch targets are smaller than 44 px

✓ Fixed · commit a17c2bb A tap 9 px below a circle completes the task; the lane name is 44 px high; the other small controls take taps 5 to 8 px outside their drawn box.

Observation

Measured on the phone layout: task checkboxes 22 × 22 px (18 × 18 on Kanban cards), lane names 26 px high, Clear dates 28 × 28, priority and tag chips 30 px, the List / Kanban switch 33 px, Search 36 × 36, the Tasks / Notes / Meetings / Boards switch 32 px, and the page title that opens the menu 32 px.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Measure the controls on the board, the task detail and the Archive page.

Expected

At least 44 × 44 px (Apple) or 48 dp (Android) to touch, whatever the drawn size.

Actual

18 to 36 px on the controls listed.

Impact on users and the business

Harder for people with motor difficulties and on small phones; the circle that completes a task is the smallest target and the most used.

Direction for the fix

Extend the touch area with padding or a transparent ::after, keeping the drawn size.

Where styles/components.css (.check, .seg, .chip.sm, .icon-btn), styles/screens.css (.lane-name)

BUG-16 ● Low Boards › Header C-20

The same board counts "8 open" in the list and "10 tasks" on the Kanban

✓ Fixed · commit a17c2bb List and Kanban both show "6 open" for the same board.

Observation

The small counter in the header counts open tasks in list view and all tasks, completed ones included, in Kanban view, and changes its word with it.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open a board with completed tasks in list view and read the counter.
  2. Switch to Kanban.

Expected

One number for one board, or two that are clearly different things.

Actual

"8 OPEN" becomes "10 TASKS".

Impact on users and the business

Cosmetic; a moment of doubt about whether tasks appeared.

Direction for the fix

Show open tasks in both views; the Done lane already has its own count.

Where src/ui/board.js (kicker text for each view)

BUG-17 ● Low Account › Age step C-45

Someone who is 18 is told "Accounts are for adults"

✓ Fixed · commit a17c2bb The refusal reads "No account yet · Accounts open from the year after your 18th birthday". The rule is unchanged.

Observation

The age step asks only for the year of birth and accepts people who were 18 on 1 January. Anyone who turned 18 during this year is refused, with wording that says they are not an adult, and the refusal is kept for 24 hours.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Settings › Account › Sign in › Create an account.
  2. Choose the year that makes you 18 this year (2008 in 2026) and continue.

Expected

Either the account, or a message that fits ("Accounts open from the year after you turn 18").

Actual

"Accounts are for adults."

Impact on users and the business

A small group, but each of them is wrongly told off and locked out for a day. Once the store age signals are live (built in this release), a store-confirmed adult skips this step.

Direction for the fix

Reword the refusal for that one year, or ask the month as well when the year is the boundary year.

Where src/account.js:61 (checkAge); src/ui/signin.js (age step)

BUG-18 ● Low Performance C-49

Every action redraws the whole screen, which gets slow with thousands of tasks

✓ Fixed · third batch, 21 Nov A list, and each Kanban lane, draws 100 tasks at a time with "Show 100 more". With 5,000 tasks: a redraw takes 17 ms (was 518), a saved change 24 ms (was 616), opening the Kanban 51 ms (was 543). A full storage now shows a message instead of failing without a word.

Observation

With 5,000 tasks (1,255 on the open board), one redraw takes 0.5 to 0.7 s on a desktop processor: ticking a task, switching view, anything. With 1,000 tasks it takes 70 to 90 ms. All data lives in one browser storage entry of at most about 5 MB; 5,000 tasks and 500 notes used 2.4 MB, so the ceiling is near 10,000 tasks.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Load 5,000 tasks across the four boards.
  2. Tick a task or switch between List and Kanban.

Expected

Under 100 ms per action at any realistic size.

Actual

518 ms redraw, 616 ms per saved change, 543 ms to open Kanban.

Impact on users and the business

Nobody reaches this in the first months. A long-term user with a busy board will feel the app slow down, and one day saving will fail when storage is full.

Direction for the fix

Draw only the rows in view for long lists, and warn before storage fills up. Longer term, move the data to IndexedDB.

Where app.js (render replaces the whole screen); src/store.js (one localStorage entry)

BUG-19 ● Low Meetings › Recording C-35

The web app also says "Recording keeps going if the screen locks"

✓ Fixed · commit a17c2bb The browser says "Keep Stack'd open and the screen on while recording"; the lock-screen line is for the apps only.

Observation

The line under the recording clock is shown everywhere. It is true in the iOS and Android apps, which keep recording behind the lock screen. In a browser or an installed web app the recording stops when the phone locks.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open the web app on a phone and start a recording.

Expected

The line only in the apps; on the web, "Keep the screen on while recording".

Actual

The same promise on the web.

Impact on users and the business

A web user who trusts the line loses the rest of the meeting.

Direction for the fix

Show the line only when the native recording service is present.

Where src/ui/recorder.js:175

5 Visual evidence

22 annotated screenshots, captured at 412 × 839 CSS px when each issue was reproduced. Numbered boxes match the numbered notes under each figure on the bug pages. Select a bug ID to open its write-up.

6 Our recommendation

Update, 21 November: five of the six pre-release fixes are done. What remains of the release gate is BUG-02, the legal pages, plus the device checks listed under "Before a store release". The original verdict follows.
Verdict: continue TestFlight testing now. Hold the store release until the six pre-release fixes pass a re-test. Stack'd Minimalist does what it promises where it matters most: tasks and dates are handled correctly, the gestures work, data stays on the device and survives being offline. I would not put it in front of the public as it is. On the main navigation path a tap opens the wrong screen, one Settings control does nothing, a card can be filed in the wrong lane, a recording can be uploaded before the user is told a plan is needed, one of the four main actions is a placeholder, and the legal pages are not finished. Those six are the release gate. None of them needs new design, and five are code changes of a few lines each. The rest can follow in updates without risk to anyone's data.

Fix before a store release 6

Two High defects and the four Medium ones that break a control, misfile or send data, or put a placeholder on the main action. All are small, local changes except the legal pages, which are the owner's and the lawyer's.

  • BUG-01 ▲ High Picking a board in the main menu also opens a task ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-02 ▲ High Privacy Policy and Terms have unfilled placeholders, and their links do not open ● Open
  • BUG-03 ◆ Medium Deleting a label does nothing ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-04 ◆ Medium After the board scrolls by itself, a card drops into the wrong lane ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-05 ◆ Medium On a Free device, the first Transcribe sends the recording before the plan is checked ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-07 ◆ Medium "Add automation" leads to a "coming soon" row ✓ Fixed

Ship in the first update 7

Real defects with contained impact or a workaround.

  • BUG-06 ◆ Medium A monthly task due on the 29th to 31st drifts to the 28th ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-08 ◆ Medium In the list, a task cannot be opened from the keyboard, and every checkbox has the same name ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-09 ● Low The toast lies on top of the action sheet and takes its taps ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-10 ● Low A long tag runs off the card and cannot be removed there ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-12 ● Low Record does nothing, without a word, when the recording store cannot be opened ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-15 ● Low Many touch targets are smaller than 44 px ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-19 ● Low The web app also says "Recording keeps going if the screen locks" ✓ Fixed

Polish backlog 6

Cosmetic or edge-case issues that can ride along with any later release.

  • BUG-11 ● Low Two boards, lanes or priorities can have the same name ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-13 ● Low An empty title or board name is refused without a message ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-14 ● Low Priority chips run in opposite orders on two screens ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-16 ● Low The same board counts "8 open" in the list and "10 tasks" on the Kanban ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-17 ● Low Someone who is 18 is told "Accounts are for adults" ✓ Fixed
  • BUG-18 ● Low Every action redraws the whole screen, which gets slow with thousands of tasks ✓ Fixed

Before a store release, also

  • Check BUG-01 on an iPhone. It was reproduced in Chromium, the engine of the Android app; iOS may or may not deliver the stray click.
  • Run the blocked criteria on real devices: a store purchase and restore, one real transcript and summary, reminders with the app closed, and the keyboard surround fixed in build 15.
  • Add a check for undefined names (a lint rule) to npm run check. It would have caught BUG-03 before any build.
  • Add the month-end case and the "drop after auto-scroll" case to the project's checks, so both stay fixed.

Ready as it stands

  • Task entry, completion, repeating dates (other than month ends), sorting and manual order.
  • Kanban: moving cards, the delete badge, adding, renaming, reordering and removing lanes.
  • Notes with drafts, formatting, checklists, tags and colours; search everywhere.
  • Archive and the 30-day bin for tasks, notes, meetings and whole boards.
  • Recording, pasted transcripts, minutes and action cards that become linked tasks.
  • Import and export, themes, date formats, offline use, and the project's own suites (all green).

Method. Flows were driven through the real UI in a phone-sized Chromium profile with touch events, and results were read both from the screen and from the stored data. Suspected defects were confirmed in the source before being reported. Two early suspicions turned out to be test-tool errors and were left out. Not covered: behaviour on physical devices, real store billing, the live AI service, and accounts against a deployed server.

Stack'd Minimalist 1.6.0 · Deep Testing Report · 21 November 2026
